scope: Independent read-only source review of the combined primary evidence assembler; no assembler execution or new acquisition by this reviewer.
checks: Requires all six terminal primary audit files and refuses to overwrite an existing final index.
Binds the fixed independent auditor and expected-input source hashes; validates exact original log and tagged-record byte identities.
Checks each job/run, dictionary/order, source tree and commit, native package entry hashes, fixture, browser, production-default requested flags and storage total.
Preserves every per-host candidate/control ratio, uncertainty interval, memory coverage failure and gate result.
Compares same-arm package entry maps and same-corpus persisted semantic digests across the six jobs.
Reports registered count completeness explicitly and never computes a pooled effect or an automatic promotion.
limits: This assembler indexes source-bound, already-audited statistics; it is not a second independent recomputation of browser timers.
A failed count or performance gate remains visible; the parent still reviews both original raw-archive audits and non-target uncertainty.
